review_notes: Final precision/saturation review used only the allowed Doc25 Raw + components raw schematic, overlay, and crops, plus the requested Diego/Jennifer review artifacts for comparison.
Diego round2 exactly matches Jennifer round1 on node objects, matrix_order, asserted edge order/set, rejected_non_edges, and 204-edge symmetric matrix.

No final correction was visually necessary: the 204 asserted edges remain direct visible adjacencies through explicit devices, bus taps, solid DC/power lines, supported dashed trip/control routes, supported dotted instrument drops, and ground drops.
The two 480V charger feeder candidates remain uncertain rather than asserted because the raw lower crops show routed/off-sheet feeder markers without unambiguous visible charger input terminals.
Crossings and nearby repeated structures without visible junction/terminal dots remain rejected or uncertain; no label correction was supported in the allowed raw/overlay/crops.
No GT, GT-derived feedback, Raw+wires resources, existing Doc25 wires scripts, or OCR engines were used.
